reviews.text: Your website says “ Pulaski Animal Hospital offers emergency care for pets.” Came in because my dog kept on throwing up- walk in to an empty waiting room and the staff all in a room talking (except for one on a phone call).  they didn’t have a pet in the room.   Then I explain what is going on - oh we don’t do walk-ins.  And we’re completely booked.  As I scan the completely empty room. False advertisement- not an emergent clinic.  How am I supposed to schedule for an emergency - Disappointed.  I have had all of my dogs come to this facility and all my family as well And when we need them the most. They were like oh well sorry. Ba-bye.
They don’t care
The vet is good here but front desk and scheduling is not organized at all. It use to be great but not recently.
I love this clinic my family has been coming for 20 years! The prices are so affordable compared to other places ! Love love love the vet technicians and the front desk.
Professional

I went to Pulaski animal hospital for help with my cat, my cat was drinking more water than normal. I thought it might be diabetic or kidney issues so I wanted blood work. They gave me medication to give my cat and it was way to strong and my cat could not move or stand up my cat was acting as if were dying.  I slept on the floor with my cat and brought my cat back to see the doctor and the older doctor told me to much medication was given and their was nothing they can do the cat is old anyway. What type of comment is this from a professional who suppose to be helping make the my animal better?
I love this vet.  I have 3 cats and 2 dogs.  Prices are good.  Staff is great.

I took my dog ​​there about two years ago because he wasn't eating and was in pain—his hind leg was hurting, and there seemed to be an issue with his stomach. These people told me it was just old age, or maybe a spinal issue, or perhaps a leg injury. It turned out that when I took him to a different clinic last month, they found a tumor that was compressing his organs. He also had an enlarged heart—things that could have been spotted with a simple X-ray. He passed away because the condition wasn't detected in time; I don't understand why they couldn't have done the same thing back then. Maybe the problem could have been caught earlier. The point is: take care of your pets and don't take them there—those people don't know what they're doing. All they care about is getting paid. Please be very careful.

The staff are sincere and work hard to help your fur babies. There are no bells and whistles like free toys or treats or even an app to download your visits. But that’s ok bc the cost of having those perks would go into the cost of our visits and services so I am ok with better care by the staff and veterinarian than having a pretty and modern office. Money should be spent on what’s important… the health of your pet.

I just took my dog today and had also taken my other dog, they are the best animal hospital I have been in. They’re all so kind and loving to the animals. I have always been treated nicely and well, so have my dogs!! Definitely recommend this for your pets! Price is also pretty affordable.

Thanks for all the care you guys provide to my little one until her
last day

I brought my dog here for years! Trusted that they cared for my pet's care/health & not just a payment. Dr. Kalata,Dr. Vega and Dr. Spinder misdiagnosed and over looked that my dog had a MASSIVE TUMOR TAKING UP HIS WHOLE ABDOMEN. Let's start with Dr. Kalata he saw my dog every 2-3 months for Cushing Disease. He over looked the whole 2 years to ever do a follow up ultrasounds/x-rays or any other type of testing knowing my dog also had to be neutered due to cancer. I trusted that they would tell me what needs to be done to keep my pet healthy. We also only got the Cushing disease diagnosed because my husband made sure to tell him to check our dog because of symptoms we noticed. He than only then went back out to do further testing. That should've been our red flag to leave and look for a different vet. After all that we thought we were keeping my dog up to date with his health I had to request another full work up just to make sure our dog was doing well. "Tests" were done but honestly only blood work was done. Because if my dogs stomach would've been touched on his stomach that tumor AS A DOCTOR they would've felt the difference from a pot belly from cushing disease or a tumor!! I got a call that "he was perfectly healthy no worries" literal words from Dr. Kalata but we always stated his stomach was getting big & he was losing mobility in his back legs. Dr. Kalata brushed us off by saying it was due to cushing disease & him being old. Turns out it was actually the tumor being to heavy & bothering him. 2 weeks after that "full work up" we had to let our dog go and say goodbye.
I called the clinic but they were NEVER PROMPT TO CALL BACK!! I was the one following up all the time. This time I called to get my dog seen since Monday for not feeling well and I didn't hear back from them until I CALLER BACK Tuesday afternoon & then they said "oh yeah you called yesterday bring him in at 4 today" it was 2pm when I called!! When were they going to inform me to take my sick dog in!?So I ended up seeing Dr. Vega that day. He swore my dog was stable and it was just an emergency surgery for a spleenoctomy to rush him to an ER pet hospital THAT THEY RECOMMENDED BECAUSE DR. VEGA WORKED WITH THEM!. At the vet ER they said they actually couldn't even find his spleen because all his organs were being squished by the tumor. So the best option for my dog was to let him go because he was suffering.
I called a few days later here to pulaski animal hospital & asked to have one of the vets called me again no follow up. I let a few days go and I HAD TO CALL AGAIN TO GET ANSWERS!! Dr. Spinder is the head surgeon so he called me back on his way home instead of while in the office to be able to read the notes. He basically said that I brought my dog in late in the day and the doctors were going home so they couldn't/didn't want to work on my dog! So when I questioned if he was serious he said they didn't have the equipment. But you're a hospital? He also said I didn't understand & that I thought I was a doctor but that "I was incompetent and wrong" then I asked well I agree that your doctors are as well because I was using the same sentences Dr. Vega and the ER vet told me!! He then gave me the run around & didn't take any responsibility of missing that tumor. He couldn't answer questions I asked. He would say one thing and then change his answer and say I was wrong and "didn't understand why we were even talking it didn't matter" My pet matters!!He also said that he would disagree with what the ER vet stated!!! The same ER THEY SENT ME TO BECAUSE THEY ARE GOOD! HOW CAN YOU SAY THEY ARE WRONG BUT NOT YOUR EMPLOYEES!!! Then he hung up on me because "he got home and needed to go inside" literally his sentence before hanging up on me!!
There is more details but this is all what it comes too! I lost mt dog over the DOCTORS NOT DOING THEIR JOB! Dr. Spinder said I wasn't the doctor but in the same conversation said I should've asked for more test?!What a joke of doctors & clinic!!
DO NOT GO UNLESS YOU ARE THE DOCTOR AND KNOW MORE THAN THEM APPARENTLY!!!

I recently had to make the heartbreaking decision to say goodbye to my 19-year-old cat, Ophelia, and I’m so grateful to the team at Pulaski Animal Hospital—especially Dr. Vega.

Dr. Vega was incredibly gentle, kind, and patient with both of us. He made sure Ophie was comfortable and gave me the time and space I needed to say goodbye without feeling rushed.

Because of his care, her final moments were peaceful and full of love. I will always be thankful for the compassion shown to us during such a difficult time.
After 3 vets opinions Pulaski animal hospital where the most honest to what my dog really needed. Instead of a 2,000 dollar surgery she only needed to be spayed. Thanks for the honesty and care.

I brought my dog Cocoa here a few times over the years and just recently had to say goodbye to her, and I cannot express how grateful I am to the staff for being so kind to us during the process including Dr. Kalata. I really appreciate this place.

I been taking my dog here for a few years doctor’s are excellent but front desk staff have a horrible service they have attitudes and if you call they don’t even greet you they just put you on hold or hang up on you they need better customer service I’m planning on looking for another place for my furry baby.

Took my cat there twice he's still sick they claim they gave him an antibiotic but I don't think they did they didn't give us any oral medication to take home just told us to come in 2 weeks if he's still sick they would do blood work
Its an ok place not the best not the cheapest. 5k$ after a one night stay for my pup.
Dr Spinder and his staff are the best of the best kind caring knowledgeable thorough Doc follows up personally explains everything in detail

Excellent service and attention to both customers and pets. They took great care of my dog ​​from when she was a puppy until she passed away at 13 years old. It's the best hospital I've found for animal health and care! I recommend it 100%! 😁👍 …

Very unreliable. This place never has consistent vets available and the ones I’ve seen for my pet don’t take my concerns seriously. Before my pet was finally diagnosed with asthma, I had told the vet her symptoms for months but they didn’t do the testing needed until I pushed for it. They said it was probably nothing, just a normal cough and when the x rays came back it turned out to be asthma. I did a basic google search on her symptoms and knew immediately it was asthma. How would a licensed vet not realize what was going on after me telling her the same symptoms I googled to find out it was asthma? It feels like I need to have veterinary knowledge so that I can ask the appropriate questions to get to the bottom of things, when it should be the other way around.

The office staff isn’t any better. I’ve had to call them multiple times to follow up on questions I have for the vet or prescriptions that I needed completed and they always say they’ll call me back and never do. I know if I don’t follow up it won’t get done and when I do call back they’re not aware of the situation. They’ve also given me the wrong prescription before, don’t fully disclose after-effects of certain treatments, and failed to tell me that a tooth fragment was left behind from a previous extraction. When I address these concerns to them they give empty disingenuous apologies, but no explanations and these problems persist.

I don’t know if the problems are due to management or individual staff members, but something needs to change to fix these issues. If it weren’t for the location I wouldn’t come back here again but it’s the most convenient for my pet who doesn’t travel well.

I've been a client of Balaskys Animal Hospital close to 30 year's. Their veterinarians are above spectacular, and the girls at front desk are always kind, helpful and informative after all visits. I'm greatful being a long time client with all of my animals at this practice.

I can not express enough gratitude I have for this clinic. Every time I come here I'm greeted with kindness and compassion. The Doctors and staff here are all wonderful. Dr. Kalata is very informative and thorough when explaining what my dog Bella needs. The phone calls and status updates are always in a timely manner. I'm always pleased with the service here. I highly recommend Pulaski Animal Hospital.

Our dog cut herself (3"), went to this place, was told can't do-nothing unless an appointment is made.
Anything I asked, dog next to me, she said no, unless you have an appointment.

Made a phone call yesterday asking for an appointment since my dog has been having issues using the restroom and the lady on the phone said it would be OK just to come in from the hours of nine and 12 in the parking lot and just get seen right away like that when I went in today They basically said that there’s no doctor for my dog to be seen so whoever the front desk gave misinformation, thanks a lot

Always booked months in advance. And then when you are finally able to get an appointment (and call off work for it), they cancel on you because their doctors are "busy". This happened literally two times within the same week and kept moving me around. Might need to find a different vet.
Doctors and staff are wonderful to work with. They treat everyone with respect and care for our adopted family members. Highly recommended.

Very accommodating.
Pleasant employees.
Clean inside.
Sucks they only want to make money off your pets pain no consideration for pets.

This is an appointment based vet. The appointments no matter what, are always 2-4 weeks away from when you actually need to be seen by a veterinarian. Who in their right mind would have a vet clinic not open to walk ins? Or at least have the ability to make appointments much sooner compared to what is currently being offered. I hope this place closes.
The best animal hospital I know. I use it for my dogs even though I live quite far away.

The staff and vet were incredibly kind and patient with me and my father yesterday during the difficult process of helping my dog cross rainbow bridge. Thank you to everyone at Pulaski Animal Hospital.
Close to the house prices are very high.Always different doctors and they take forever to answer the phone.They keep putting you on hold.  Just go for regular yearly shots
Called today and they saw me today. Thank you for taking care of Lilly. I was so nervous but they were patient and very informative so I left feeling better and Lilly is feeling good also.
Theviwners of this pet clinic make People  appointments and thet receive you 3 hours  later.. not nice service.

Doctors Adam and Stan are the most attentive vets I have visited.
Two of my doggies went through surgery and results were top notch.
Excellent service and attentive staff.
They will go above and beyond to get your pets well .
Thank you Pulaski Animal Hospital!!

I was with my dog Scooby at this Vets office today. Our doctor was Dr. Kalata, first time with him and we absolutely loved him as our doctor. The Vet Techs and all receptionists were so kind and understanding of my Scooby. He's a german shepherd 113 lbs he is very scared and nervous going to the Vet yet. I bet the Vet's office has a good video of me trying to get him in the office lol....maybe they can post it on Facebook to show you can't give up ! We were able to get all his shots and nails trimmed. Dr. Kalata and the Polish Vet tech, didn't catch her name were fabulous with my Scooby. Thank you everyone at Pulaski Animal Hospital and I mean EVERYONE.

We had been going here for over 10 years. We absolutely loved Dr Kristy. Things changed since the pandemic.  I had a dog with CHF who needed to be seen as a walk in. We waited in the parking lot for hours in the heat (90+ degrees) and had to be seen in the utility closet because she had a cough. My dog who had addison's disease needed to be seen as a walk in. We wait in the parking lot for hours (90+ degrees) they can suffer from crisis if stressed. Appointments are weeks out. Recently I needed an ER follow up from VEG hospital for liver disease and other organ issues. First available appointment was 6 weeks out.
I pulled my 3 dogs records and switched to LePar animal hospital. We were able to get an appointment a week. LePar is more expensive but they are fully staffed with availability. Very kind and patient since we have a very complex case that may not have a good prognosis.
Dr Kristy was the reason we didn't switch sooner.
Dr Kristy will be sorely missed as we felt so comfortable with her and her care for our pets.
I don't know what happened at Pulaski animal hospital but it isn't the same. The 3 stars are for Dr Kristy.  She deserves 5
I cannot express how much I love the Doctors and Staff here. We have 2 elderly cats and have been coming here for the last 6 years. We always leave feeling confident our baby girls are in good hands.
Unbelievable how they turn away the community!!! The system does not work for the community!!! Favoritism here!!! Close down if you cannot serve the community!!!
So far so good since my dog has needed constant appointments for his illness.
Dentistry here is expensive
I like how thorough the veterinarian is and they have much more reasonable prices than so many others.

Hello everyone I was want to leave a review because I had a stressful event happened to my dog today. My dog had an unexpected injury on one nail on his paw. I knew he needed to be attended immediately. Thankfully, I live walking distance and I explained I have an emergency my dog’s nail is popped up and bleeding. Good care,fast care, was given medication and was attended very well. Great location, great staff and great services. Thank you so much to all at this location to attended and help my baby. Definitely recommend
Fast and helpful service they will take care of you pets and kind
Love the staff very nice and helpful
Helped my old dog that has been a patient there for 12 years with his cushing's and possibly a cancer lump

I had taken my dog here after looking up the closet animal hospital to my home after my dog got run over. I arrived parked and waited outside after 15 mins I was let in( it was before opening) and asked if I should sit or wait or if I could check in the vet tech then asked me what was going on I told her what happened involving my dog and that I wanted an initial exam and the works after we figure out whats going after that traumatic hit. I was then told the head veterinarian was in surgery and that I had to make an appointment and if I did want to make an appointment I wouldn’t be able to because they’re full booked for that day. To top it I had just got off working a 16 hr shift and still managed to make it there at 8:30 and talk to someone and be seen before they were even open because online it says they take walk ins only to be told to my face they haven’t done that since Covid. You would think the vet techs there would learn how to approach people better in these kinds of situations since they deal with them daily  and not have an attitude regardless of the time of day. They need to update their website. And lastly she then proceeded to give me papers with suggestions for an emergency vet I’m like girl you are right here by my house I rushed over here for that reason and are the most affordable as well I asked her if she knew the pricing for the places she was suggesting and she said no. It was mind boggling if you’re going to make suggestions at the very least have the price differences listed. The whole experience was super upsetting.

I'd like to sincerely thank all the staff who cared for my Mia. Thank you to Dr. St. Kalata and the other doctors. The clinic is wonderful and trustworthy, and I recommend it to anyone who needs help for their pets. They welcome our pets with open arms and help save their lives!—even their lives. Thank you!

I have been a loyal customer to Pulaski for many years. Dr Kowalxzyk was the best and super sweet. Lately I feel the newer staff members are not as nice as they used to be there. I recently called to get my cat euthanized and I had to make an appointment?!! Um if I have to euthanize my pet it’s not because I want to, but because he is suffering and you have to book an appointment 4 days later Because you have no openings?? I was forced to take him elsewhere, and was told I didn’t need an appointment at all and just come right in for something that serious.
Very caring people work here! Thank you for all you do!
Dr. Szpindor and staff took great care of our elderly cat. Thank you!
